name: flisk
description: Run your whole app on your own computer with one command. Skills and an MCP server that let your coding agent build, start, check and fix a local stack with the Flisk CLI.

interface.longDescription: Flisk runs your whole app on your own computer with one command: frontends, APIs, workers, AI agents and MCP servers, with their databases. Ask for a shop, a SaaS or an AI agent and your agent scaffolds the services with flisk resource, starts them with flisk up, checks every URL and fixes what fails with flisk doctor. Free and open source (MIT), no signup and no API key. Flisk never calls a model itself. Needs the Flisk CLI on your computer: npm install -g @flisk-sh/flisk.
defaultPrompt: Build me a small online shop with a storefront and an orders API, and run it on my laptop with Flisk.
Start my Flisk stack and tell me which URLs are up.
My Flisk app is broken: run flisk doctor, find the cause and fix it.
